name: Rasterization-based Voxelization Shader
definition: A fragment shader that rasterizes geometry into a 3D grid volume by mapping clip-space coordinates to grid indices and writing a value to a structured buffer.
summary: A fragment shader that rasterizes geometry into a 3D grid volume, differing from standard voxelization by producing volumetric data like occupancy or spherical harmonic coefficients directly on the GPU.
